title: Etale neighbourhoods realize finite separable residue field extensions
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $s\in S$, and let $k$ be a finite field extension of the residue field $\kappa(s)$ [def-weil-residue-field] [def-pc-field-extension] which is separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Then there are a scheme $U$, an etale morphism $\varphi:U\to S$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] and a point $u\in U$ with $\varphi(u)=s$ such that the residue field $\kappa(u)$, regarded as an extension of $\kappa(s)$ through the map $\kappa(s)\to\kappa(u)$ induced by $\varphi$, is isomorphic to $k$ as an extension of $\kappa(s)$ (there is a field isomorphism $k\to\kappa(u)$ which is the identity on $\kappa(s)$).

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma 02LF (more-morphisms-lemma-realize-prescribed-residue-field-extension-etale, line 10138); its proof reduces to S affine and Algebra, Lemma 00UD (algebra-lemma-make-etale-map-prescribed-residue-field)

proof.text: Affine chart. Since $S$ is a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $s$ has an affine open neighbourhood $W\subseteq S$; put $R=\mathcal O_S(W)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points] there are an open immersion $\iota:\operatorname{Spec}R\to S$ [def-weil-open-immersion] with image $W$ and a prime $\mathfrak p\subset R$ with $\iota(\mathfrak p)=s$. By [lem-weil-pbc-residue-field-point-naturality] (its last clause, $\iota$ an open immersion) the map $\rho:\kappa(s)\to\kappa_{\operatorname{Spec}R}(\mathfrak p)$ induced by $\iota$ on residue fields [def-weil-residue-field] is an isomorphism, and by [lem-weil-pbc-spec-residue-field-identification] there is an isomorphism $e_R:\kappa_{\operatorname{Spec}R}(\mathfrak p)\to\kappa(\mathfrak p)=R_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] induced by $\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}R,\mathfrak p}\cong R_{\mathfrak p}$. Put $\theta=e_R\circ\rho:\kappa(s)\xrightarrow{\sim}\kappa(\mathfrak p)$.

source.place: More on Morphisms, proof of Lemma 02LF (line 10148-10152): 'We may assume S is affine'

proof.text: Transport of $k$. Let $j:\kappa(s)\to k$ be the structure map of the extension $k/\kappa(s)$ [def-pc-field-extension]. Let $L$ be the field $k$ regarded as an extension of $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ through $j\circ\theta^{-1}:\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to k$. Since $\theta$ is a field isomorphism, a $\kappa(s)$-basis of $k$ is a $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$-basis of $L$, so $L$ is finite over $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$; and $\theta$ extends coefficientwise to a ring isomorphism $\kappa(s)[T]\to\kappa(\mathfrak p)[T]$ that preserves monic polynomials, irreducibility, degrees, derivatives and coprimality and is compatible with evaluation at any $\alpha\in k$ (via $j$, resp. $j\circ\theta^{-1}$), so it maps the minimal polynomial of $\alpha$ over $\kappa(s)$ to the minimal polynomial of $\alpha$ over $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$, and the latter is separable because the former is. Hence $L/\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ is finite and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension].

source.place: More on Morphisms, proof of Lemma 02LF (line 10148-10152); the transport along kappa(s) = kappa(p) is implicit in 'we may assume S is affine' and written by the agent

proof.text: Etale ring map. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-map-prescribed-residue-field] to $R$, $\mathfrak p$ and the finite separable algebraic extension $L/\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ of step 2: there are a ring map $\psi:R\to R'$ with $\operatorname{Spec}\psi:\operatorname{Spec}R'\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], a prime $\mathfrak p'\subset R'$ with $\psi^{-1}(\mathfrak p')=\mathfrak p$, and a field isomorphism $\lambda:\kappa(\mathfrak p')\to L=k$ with $\lambda\circ\kappa(\psi)=j\circ\theta^{-1}$, where $\kappa(\psi):\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to\kappa(\mathfrak p')$ is induced by $\psi$.

source.place: More on Morphisms, proof of Lemma 02LF (line 10150-10151): 'the lemma follows from Algebra, Lemma 00UD'

proof.text: The neighbourhood. Put $U=\operatorname{Spec}R'$, $\varphi=\iota\circ\operatorname{Spec}\psi:U\to S$ and $u=\mathfrak p'\in U$. The open immersion $\iota$ is etale and the composite of the etale morphisms $\operatorname{Spec}\psi$ and $\iota$ is etale, by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation] (1) and (2); so $\varphi$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. By [lem-weil-pbc-spec-map-residue-field-naturality] (1), $\operatorname{Spec}\psi(\mathfrak p')=\psi^{-1}(\mathfrak p')=\mathfrak p$, hence $\varphi(u)=\iota(\mathfrak p)=s$.

source.place: More on Morphisms, proof of Lemma 02LF (line 10148-10152), the return from the affine case, written by the agent

proof.text:
The residue field. Let $r_\varphi:\kappa(s)	o\kappa(u)$, $r_\psi:\kappa_{\operatorname{Spec}R}(\mathfrak p)	o\kappa(u)=\kappa_{\operatorname{Spec}R'}(\mathfrak p')$ be the maps induced on residue fields [def-weil-residue-field] by $\varphi$ and $\operatorname{Spec}\psi$. The local homomorphism of stalks induced by a composite of morphisms of schemes is the composite of the induced local homomorphisms, hence so are the maps on residue fields: $r_\varphi=r_\psi\circho$. By [lem-weil-pbc-spec-map-residue-field-naturality] (2), $e_{R'}\circ r_\psi=\kappa(\psi)\circ e_R$, with $e_{R'}:\kappa(u)\xrightarrow{\sim}\kappa(\mathfrak p')$ the isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-spec-residue-field-identification] for $R'$. Therefore $e_{R'}\circ r_\varphi=\kappa(\psi)\circ e_R\circho=\kappa(\psi)\circ	heta$. Let $
u=e_{R'}^{-1}\circ\lambda^{-1}:k	o\kappa(u)$, a field isomorphism. From $\lambda\circ\kappa(\psi)=j\circ	heta^{-1}$ (step 3) we get $\lambda^{-1}\circ j=\kappa(\psi)\circ	heta$, so $
u\circ j=e_{R'}^{-1}\circ\kappa(\psi)\circ	heta=r_\varphi$: $
u$ is an isomorphism $k	o\kappa(u)$ of extensions of $\kappa(s)$ (it is the identity on $\kappa(s)$, where $\kappa(s)$ sits in $k$ by $j$ and in $\kappa(u)$ by $r_\varphi$). With step 4 this is the assertion.

New unsplit nodes: lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-map-prescribed-residue-field (00UD; no Mathlib match: Mathlib's etale-neighbourhood existence results all have bijective residue field map), lem-weil-pbc-spec-map-residue-field-naturality (no exact match; (1) is Spec.map_apply, (2) follows in a few lines from Scheme.localRingHom_comp_stalkIso). lean.statement: theorem Scheme.exists_etale_neighbourhood_prescribed_residueField (S : Scheme.{u}) (s : S) (k : Type v) [Field k] [Algebra (S.residueField s) k] [FiniteDimensional (S.residueField s) k] [Algebra.IsSeparable (S.residueField s) k] : ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (φ : U ⟶ S), Etale φ ∧ ∃ (u : U) (h : φ u = s) (e : k ≃+* U.residueField u), ∀ a : S.residueField s, e (algebraMap (S.residueField s) k a) = (φ.residueFieldMap u).hom ((S.residueFieldCongr h).inv.hom a)
